# uv: an explicit index for this project only (pyproject.toml)
# explicit = true keeps every other dependency on its usual index.
[[tool.uv.index]]
name = "polaris-key"
url = "https://pkg.plrs.im/pypi/polaris-key/simple/"
explicit = true

[tool.uv.sources]
"polaris-key" = { index = "polaris-key" }

# Poetry 2: an explicit source
poetry source add --priority=explicit polaris-key https://pkg.plrs.im/pypi/polaris-key/simple/
poetry add --source polaris-key polaris-key==0.9.0

# pip: the package alone, without its dependencies
# Warning: Never add this feed with --extra-index-url. pip has no per-project routing: with two indexes it takes the highest version from either, so a public package with the same name could win.
# pip cannot route one project to one index: install the dependencies from your usual index first, then this package from the feed.
pip install --no-deps --index-url https://pkg.plrs.im/pypi/polaris-key/simple/ polaris-key==0.9.0
